body: Merged main into the branch to resolve the conflict (commit 51074ea0). The one conflicting hunk was the MCP module list in `crates/app/src/mcp/mod.rs`: kept `wcs_circle` (this PR) together with `vise_tools` and `accessory_tools` (main). Checked on the merge: circle_centre, mcp, mcp_accessory, mcp_vise, mcp_pick, mcp_setup, mcp_model all pass. Ready for a re-check.

This conflicts with main again. The one open hunk is `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs`: this PR moves `wcs_page` out to `wcs_page.rs`, while main has since edited the old inline copy in place (`0e8e3603`/`a64d782e` - the plain "Work offset (G54-G59)" wording and the WCS-page guard). Keeping both sides mechanically is not right here: main's edits need to be ported into the moved `wcs_page.rs`, then the inline copy dropped. Please run `git merge upstream/main` (or `/resolve-conflicts`), port those hunks, and push. No action taken from our side.

Merged main to resolve conflicts (crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs: kept both sides). Main reworded two lines of wcs_page (the readout comment and the work-offset note) while this PR moved the page into wcs_page.rs; the new wording is ported into wcs_page.rs, no WCS logic or math changed. Targeted gate: quick app suites green, clippy -D warnings clean on camcraft-ui; ui lib has one failure, diag::tests::shared_ui_code_prints_only_through_the_diag_seam, from crates/ui/src/refusal_ghost.rs:44 (an eprintln! on upstream main, not this PR's code). Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

Merge-time refresh attempted against current main and stopped: the conflicts are not mechanical, so nothing was pushed. Please resolve them (git merge origin/main on this branch) and push. Clashing hunks:

1. `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs` (add/add): main's #701 added a module of this name (the WCS-from-features role-pick draft: `WcsPick`, `arm`/`take`/`pause`/`collecting`, `State.wcs_pick`); this branch adds a different module with the same file name (the anchor-marker and circle-edge click routing: `take_click`, `queue_circle`, `State.wcs_ui`). `crates/ui/src/lib.rs` declares `pub mod wcs_pick` on both sides. One of the two needs a new module name, with its callers (`interact.rs`, `feature_click.rs`) following.
2. `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, `CommandKind::SetWcs` arm in `dispatch`: this branch moved the body into `state_wcs.rs` (`dispatch_set_wcs`, plus the new `SetWcsCircle` arm); main edited the same body in place (the finite-angle refusal kept, and `self.wcs_pick = None` after a landed frame, #701). The resolution has to port main's `wcs_pick = None` into `dispatch_set_wcs` / `dispatch_set_wcs_circle` without dropping the finite-angle refusal. The `mod wcs_ui` / `mod view_prefs_ui` path-module lines next to it are both-sides adds.
3. Both-sides adds, keep both: `crates/app/src/pick.rs` (`pub mod circle` + its re-export, and main's `box_pick` + re-export), `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`wcs_circle::TOOLS`, and main's `coolant_tools::TOOLS`, `wcs_tools::TOOLS`), `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (the `set_wcs_circle_centre` row and main's `set_wcs_from_features` row).

Merged `upstream/main` into the branch at the 2026-11-13T01:05Z instructions, item by item. New head `120beeae` (merge commit; no rebase, no force).

1. **`wcs_pick.rs` add/add.** Main's #701 `crates/ui/src/wcs_pick.rs` (`WcsPick`, `arm`/`take`/`pause`/`collecting`, `State.wcs_pick`) is untouched, byte for byte main's. This branch's module (anchor-marker and circle-edge click routing: `take_click`, `queue_circle`, `CIRCLE_ASK`, `State.wcs_ui`) is renamed to `crates/ui/src/wcs_circle_pick.rs`. Its callers follow: `lib.rs` (`pub mod wcs_circle_pick;`), `interact.rs` (`crate::wcs_circle_pick::take_click`), `feature_click.rs` (`crate::wcs_circle_pick::CIRCLE_ASK`), and the test `egui_app/wcs_circle_tests.rs` (`queue_circle`).
2. **`state.rs` `SetWcs` arm.** It still delegates to `state_wcs.rs`. Main's `self.wcs_pick = None; // #701` is now in both `dispatch_set_wcs` and `dispatch_set_wcs_circle`, right after `history.execute` on the success path, so a refused frame leaves the draft alone, as on main. The finite-angle refusal is kept in both (`rotation()` returns `None` -> "WCS not set: rotation angles must be finite"). Both path-module lines are kept: `mod wcs_ui` (`state_wcs.rs`) and `mod view_prefs_ui` (`state_view.rs`).
3. **Kept both sides.** `crates/app/src/pick.rs` (`pub mod circle` + re-export, and `box_pick` + re-export), `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`wcs_circle::TOOLS`, `coolant_tools::TOOLS`, `wcs_tools::TOOLS`), `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` (`set_wcs_circle_centre` row and `set_wcs_from_features` row).
4. **PROCESS_VERSION** is now **46** (upstream main 45 + 1, for the SKILL.md row). It gets renumbered at merge if another process PR lands first.

Nothing else conflicted. I also checked that main had not edited the WCS-page region this branch moved from `pages.rs` into `wcs_page.rs`, or the anchor-click block in `interact.rs`. It had not. Main's `pages.rs` changes (electrode kind, tool icons, #1197 pointer) merged automatically.

`git show --remerge-diff --stat 120beeae`: 12 files, +81/-134. That is the rename (`wcs_circle_pick.rs` +74 / `wcs_pick.rs` taken from main), `state.rs` -41 (main's in-place body dropped for the delegation), `state_wcs.rs` +2 (the two `wcs_pick = None`), one-line caller renames in `lib.rs`/`interact.rs`/`feature_click.rs`/`wcs_circle_tests.rs`, the keep-both hunks in `pick.rs`/`tools.rs`/SKILL.md, and `PROCESS_VERSION`.

**Gate** (macOS, debug, own `target/`, sccache):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run`: builds clean.
- app suites, all passing: setup_wcs 7, wcs_align 5, wcs_roles 9, mcp_wcs_features 2, circle_centre 5 (this PR's own), mcp 19, mcp_pick 6, box_pick 7, feature_pick 7, circular_pick 4, one_wcs 8, rotated_wcs 9, setup_defines_wcs 4.
- ui lib, single-threaded from `crates/ui`: 644 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored. This includes `wcs_pick_tests` (5, WCS-from-features), `wcs_circle_tests` (2) and `wcs_page_tests` (6).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Still a draft for the GUI hand check. Ready for a delta review of the remerge-diff.

2. **The port.** Main's `self.wcs_pick = None` is now on the success path of both `dispatch_set_wcs` and `dispatch_set_wcs_circle` (`state_wcs.rs:41`, `:59`). The finite-angle refusal is kept in both. Main's old inline SetWcs body is gone because it is equivalent.

   - `pick.rs` (circle plus box_pick);
   - `mcp/tools.rs` (wcs_circle, coolant_tools, wcs_tools);
   - `SKILL.md` (both rows).

**GUI hand check: passed** (the user, macOS arm64 release build of head `120beeae`, `simple.camproj` plus `simple2.step`, Tormach 1100MX, 2026-11-12 ~20:21-20:24 PT).
- **Layout:** the three collapsible sections, the 2-column origin grid, Turn X±/Y±/Z± as equal buttons, Level | Set Origin halves. On a wide pane every row spans the width and the 3x3 compass stays centred.
- **Box anchors:** Stock box, the Z level radios on one line, the 3x3 grid.
- **Circle centre:** picking the hole rim gives `Circle Ø 0.2362 in, centre (0.0000, 0.0000, 0.1000)` and the status line says `WCS (G54) origin set on the centre of circle Ø 0.2362 in`. Picking the other rim lands at Z 0.0000.
- **Refusal:** a straight edge gives `Not anchored: the picked edge is straight - pick a circular edge`, and the origin is unchanged.
- **Undo/redo:** undo returns to Z 0.1287, then redo re-applies.
- **Switching back to Stock box:** the circle pick disarms and the grid returns.

The last owed item is done. Body complete, delta review clean at this head, linked issue #739 is P6 (not paused). Flagging ready.
